findings.title: Clock is read even when the change fails
findings.why: `change` calls `now()` before `update` runs, so a failed complete, reopen or tag still reads the clock. That includes `invalid-state` and `invalid-input` failures. The `createTaskList` doc and the timestamps design say the clock is read once per successful change. A caller who supplies a sequence-based clock gets timestamps shifted by every failed operation. The fix is to read the clock only after the update is known to succeed, or to make the update lazy.

findings.title: Helper `reasons` actually returns line numbers
findings.why: The helper maps each rejection to `entry.line` and returns `number[]`, but its name says it returns reasons. It would read better as `lineNumbers`.
